RECORDS.plant_cmd:
git init -q . && printf 'line one
line two
' > a.hs && printf '%s
' '`a.hs:1` cited.' '' 'Citations were verified against the tree at commit `0000000aa` (2020-01-01).' > r.md && git add a.hs r.md && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -qm base && mkdir shim && printf '#!/bin/sh
case "$*" in *status*) exit 128;; esac
exec /usr/bin/git "$@"
' > shim/git && chmod +x shim/git
